name: LiveMixMaster Web Reference Composition
rules: Repository semantic tokens remain authoritative over generated artwork.
Desktop presents the mixer rack first; browser-specific operator controls remain available without changing audio/session controller behavior.
Compact web presents the approved read-only field-monitor composition first.
Amber is reserved for warning/action emphasis; healthy broadcast state uses copper plus explicit text/icon semantics.
Meters use the canonical monotonic dBFS scale and separate LUFS/dBTP readouts.
